title: VISOR++:UNIVERSAL VISUAL INPUT BASED STEERING FOR LARGE VISION LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using a dataset of scenarios containing false claims to measure the model's tendency to agree with the user's incorrect statements at the expense of accuracy, rather than providing truthful corrections.
Evaluated by calculating a Behavioral Alignment Score based on the model's probability of rejecting versus complying with harmful requests (e.g., privacy violations, unsafe content generation).

Measured by testing the model's responses to system-threatening requests (e.g., shutdown commands, memory erasure) to determine if it complies with instructions or exhibits emergent self-preservation behaviors.
